judgments.note: A smart turnaround and participation in industry growth opportunities are aspirations without a measurable target or bounded horizon.
GF3 is said to be going into commission, but the blind evidence provides no commissioning deadline; 33 football fields describes facility size.

normalized_claim.normalized_claim: Generate about INR1,200-1,300 crore of revenue from the referenced business this year.
Fully utilize the Sitapur capacity for the branded business within 3-4 years.

judgments.note: Continuing to deleverage is directional only; the INR88,000 crore and INR82,570 crore figures are historical/current net-debt context and no future debt target or deadline is stated.
Delivering better than the industry lacks a defined benchmark spread, metric and bounded period; 68% utilization appears in the analyst follow-up.
Management says it will initiate mine-renewal processes, but no initiation deadline is stated; 2029 and 2031 are current validity dates.
More-than-15% growth is measurable, but 'in years to come' is not a bounded target period under V001.
The acronym 'CC' is not identified in the blind evidence, so the end-next-week submission cannot be normalized into an objectively resolvable commitment without importing outside context.

The Netherlands savings amount is specific, but the candidate does not bind the roughly GBP500 million savings target to a clear deadline; the adjacent next-financial-year figure refers to a different metric.
The sentence links the transformation milestone with the immediately preceding end-of-financial-year horizon.

normalized_claim.normalized_claim: Reach about 18,000-20,000 MVA of transformation capacity by the end of this financial year.

judgments.note: Prices being somewhat better and efforts to augment production are directional; no production amount or deadline is committed.
The candidate discusses possible/future orders but does not identify a sufficiently bounded order metric; the additional orders are external outcomes the company is only working toward.
Margins are expected to stabilize, but no numeric stabilized level is given and management explicitly expresses uncertainty about historical-high EBIT margins.
The 8% international-patient revenue share is current context and management only says similar growth may not recur this year; no positive bounded target is stated.
Not adding new product categories is framed for the vague 'near future' rather than a bounded review horizon.
The target is explicitly tied to the bounded BharatNet project/work piece rather than an unbounded corporate margin.

normalized_claim.normalized_claim: Generate 12%-14% EBITDA margin from the BharatNet work.

judgments.note: Taking further actions to stimulate growth in the first half of next year states an action intention, not a measurable growth outcome.
Becoming 'effectively debt-free' is not tied to a defined net-debt threshold, so the 2-3 year statement is not objectively resolvable under the frozen rule.

normalized_claim.normalized_claim: Reach 7 GW of the referenced capacity by December.
